_readme: Committed, public-facing Kosha visibility & presentation tiers, read by
dge/kosha2.html (and eventually the classic overlay). Unlike the old
localStorage-only kosha_hidden_dicts, this file applies to EVERY visitor.
public        - searchable and browsable (default when absent)
search_hidden - excluded from search results; still in the Browse list
unlisted      - excluded from search AND the Browse list; opens only
Superadmins see everything, with the tier badged on each card.
order/pins: the default presentation order for readers who set none.
